text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 274, series of 1995, is hereby
to read as follows:
"SEC. 1. To ensure that an effective mechanism and linkage is instituted
for the implementation of the Bicol Region Tourism Master Plan
(BR TMP), there is hereby created under the Office of the President a
Presidential Commission to be called the Bicol
Tourism Special
Development Project Commission which shall be responsible for the
overall coordination and supervision of the implementation of the
BRTMP. It shall be composed of the following:
-Vice-Chairman
Secretary of Tourism
Secretary of Public Works and Highways
Secretary of Transportation and
Communications
Secretary of Agrarian Reform
Secretary of Agriculture
Secretary of Interior and Local
Government
Secretary of Trade and Industry
Secretary of Environment and Natural
Secretary of Education, Culture and
Chairman of the Regional Development
Council, Region V
Governors/City Mayors of Concerned
Local Government Units (LGUs)
The Department of Tourism shall provide technical secretariat services to
the Commission."
IN REPLVING, P~CTE:

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 10~ay of
Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Five.
